$comment: Arc, Circle's stablecoin L1, live since 2026-09-16. Every value below was read off the chain itself, not off a listing. Two fields are deliberately empty: the chain has one public provider and no public block explorer yet — arcscan.org and arcscan.xyz are placeholder pages and explorer.arc.io sits behind Cloudflare Access. Both are allowed to be empty and both should be filled before this chain is followed in anger: without a second endpoint a wide eth_getLogs shares the rate limit with everything else, and without an explorer every transaction, token and block on the page has no link behind it. The roster does not carry over either — on this chain the trading wallets are separate delegated addresses, so config/wallets.json has to be rebuilt by scripts/roster.ts against Arc.
name: Arc
